dialect.detail: AcuCOBOL-GT / Acu4GL with OO extensions (OBJECT REFERENCE, CLASS ... AS, method invocation syntax :>), C$SYSTEM, C$COPY, C$DELETE, C$RUN runtime calls, HANDLE OF WINDOW, SCREEN SECTION with GUI controls, 'call client' syntax — typical of Acucorp/Micro Focus AcuCOBOL thin-client (AcuConnect) environment

purpose.domain_detail: Italian business application — video/document viewer with export to file, Excel (XLS), PDF, Word/Notepad, and email (SMTP). Likely part of a larger ERP or document management suite (PRAGMA [SV] vendor).
purpose.summary: This program presents a GUI dialog allowing the user to choose a file format (CSV or TXT) and then export/print a visualized result set to file. It supports opening the result in Word/Notepad, Excel (via a Java class), PDF export, and sending via SMTP email. It uses AcuCOBOL thin-client features to copy files to the client workstation.

notable_features: AcuCOBOL OO syntax: OBJECT REFERENCE, CLASS ... AS, :> method invocation
HANDLE OF WINDOW GUI controls (combo box, bitmap buttons)
C$SYSTEM, C$COPY, C$DELETE, C$RUN Acu runtime library calls
REPOSITORY paragraph with Java class binding (fview.Visualizza)
SCREEN SECTION with COPY-based screen definitions
Multiple COPY statements for modular screen/data definitions
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full file is 728 lines. Program is in Italian, authored by PRAGMA [SV], dated August 1999. The 'online-cics' program_type enum is used as the closest match for an AcuCOBOL GUI/thin-client interactive program (no CICS involved).
